headline: Foreign Investors Withdraw Heavily; Central Bank Checks Depreciation, Foreign Exchange Reserves Fall for a Second Consecutive Month in July | Industry & Finance
summary: Taiwan's foreign exchange reserves stood at US$594.271 billion at the end of July, down US$2.881 billion month on month. The central bank said it intervened to check currency depreciation amid foreign selling.
why: Foreign exchange reserves are a central bank's stock of foreign currency assets, and their drawdown indicates intervention to support the domestic currency.
